analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive sessions. RSI failed to exit oversold territory after entering, and MACD continues to worsen. Despite today's +3.34% rebound, the price remains below SMA20 ($28,178), with a 15.5% gap to the swing resistance ($30,570). ADX at 26.7 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (33.5) is above +DI (18.4), showing downward pressure dominance. At 22.0% of the 52-week range, the price is still at a low level.
